description:
Codify the audit event field schema so future contributors add consistent events that the ADOT collector can route and CloudWatch Insights can query predictably.

## Deliverable
A doc comment block (or small .md file in crates/mail/docs/) that defines:

### Required fields on every audit event
  audit = true              (bool literal — the routing key for ADOT)
  event.type = "<value>"    (string — see enumeration below)
  username = %username      (string — authenticated username, or "-" if not known)
  source_ip = %source_ip    (string — peer IP, or "-" if unavailable)

### event.type enumeration
  auth.login_success        user authenticated successfully
  auth.login_failure        authentication attempted but failed (wrong credentials/token)
  auth.no_credentials       request arrived with no Authorization header
  authz.forbidden           authenticated user lacks required role (operator gate)
  authz.cross_account       authenticated user requested another user's accountId
  admin.method_called       operator successfully invoked an admin method

### Optional fields (add when available)
  method = %method          JMAP method name (for JMAP-context events)
  auth.method = "basic"|"bearer_token"|"oidc_jwt"
  requested_account = %id   (for authz.cross_account)
  own_account = %id         (for authz.cross_account)

### What must NOT appear in audit events
  Passwords, tokens, Authorization header values, DB error messages,
  email content, message IDs, body text, any data governed by the
  privacy policy of the regulated customer.

### ADOT collector routing snippet (for ops documentation)
  # In otel-collector-config.yaml, route audit events to a separate exporter:
  processors:
    filter/audit:
      logs:
        include:
          match_type: strict
          record_attributes:
            - key: audit
              value: "true"
  exporters:
    awscloudwatchlogs/audit:
      log_group_name: /stoa/audit
      log_stream_name: stoa-mail
  pipelines:
    logs/audit:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [filter/audit]
      exporters: [awscloudwatchlogs/audit]

## Acceptance
- Schema doc exists and is linked from CLAUDE.md or a crates/mail/README
- Every audit event added in B2, B3, B4 conforms to this schema
title: Define and document the audit event schema
